entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Ugh, finally. Just need to make a return.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Look, I don't have a lot of time. I need to return a jersey. Can you do it or not?
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF8675309. It's the ProFit jersey.

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order, delivered on November 28th. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's the wrong size. It's just too tight across the chest. I need to either return it or get an exchange.
I understand completely. Let me just check the return eligibility for you... Yes, absolutely. That jersey is well within our 90-day return window. I can process that for you right now.
I'm generating a prepaid return label and I've just sent it to the email on file. Did you want a full refund, or would you prefer the exchange for a larger size?
An exchange. I need a size Large.

Perfect. I have processed the exchange for a size Large. And since I see you're a VIP member with VeloFit, I've gone ahead and upgraded the shipping on your replacement to complimentary overnight delivery, so you should have it tomorrow.
Oh. Okay, that's great. I appreciate that. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Once you drop the original jersey in the mail with the label, the new one will be on its way. Was there anything else I could assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Enjoy the rest of your day.
